dct_title_s: USGS Digital Raster Graphic Mosaic: Illinois
dct_description_sm: ArcGIS Image Map Layer served from a statewide raster mosaic.

A statewide raster mosaic of USGS Digital Raster Graphic (DRG) images of the 7.5-minute topographic quadrangles occurring in Illinois. These are unmodified DRG images as distributed by the USGS, except that collar information has been removed for map tiling and the data have been reprojected. The map scale is 1:24,000, and the images were scanned at 250 dpi, giving an approximate raster cell resolution of 2.5 meters.
